response.sql: WITH event_averages AS (SELECT e.event_id, e.status, AVG(b.remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG((b.spent - b.amount) / NULLIF(b.amount, 0)) AS average_overspend_rate FROM budget AS b JOIN event AS e ON e.event_id = b.link_to_event GROUP BY e.event_id, e.status), status_averages AS (SELECT status, AVG(average_remaining) AS average_remaining, AVG(average_overspend_rate) AS average_overspend_rate FROM event_averages GROUP BY status) SELECT status, average_remaining, average_overspend_rate, average_remaining / (SELECT AVG(average_remaining) FROM status_averages) AS relative_average_remaining FROM status_averages
